Reeses Peanut Butter Cup Brownies
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Sunday, December 6, 2009 - 12:14am

Ingredients




1 box brownie mix
minuature peanut butter cups

Preparation

1 Prepare brownie mix according to box directions.  2 Fill cupcake tray (with papers) halfway full. Place 1 miniature peanut butter cup until level with the batter.  3 Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes.
